name: Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited
about: Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of organic chemicals and intermediaries in India and internationally. The company offers optical brighteners for textiles, plastics, detergents, coatings, and paper industries; and emulsifiers used in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, personal care products, coatings, construction chemicals, and various industrial applications; and naphthol grounders for pigments and intermediates. Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
